components.name: Primary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--ink, #16171a); color: var(--on-ink, #fff); font: 700 17px/1.2 Archivo, sans-serif; min-height: 54px; padding: 14px 26px; border: 1.5px solid var(--ink, #16171a); border-radius: 5px; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 160ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1), background-color 200ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--ink-2, #393c43); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--cyan, #005f99); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Language Chip
components.description: Pill toggle over a checkbox; native name beside the English name.
components.css: .ds-chip input { position: absolute; opacity: 0; } .ds-chip span { display: inline-flex; gap: 7px; align-items: center; min-height: 40px; padding: 6px 14px; border: 1.5px solid #a9adb4; border-radius: 999px; font: 600 14px Archivo, sans-serif; color: #393c43; background: #fff; cursor: pointer; } .ds-chip input:checked + span { background: #16171a; border-color: #16171a; color: #fff; } .ds-chip input:focus-visible + span { outline: 2px solid #005f99; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Margin Note
components.description: Proofreader's margin mark: cyan for fixes, pencil red for review.
components.html: Shortened to fit, check the wordingThe first wording was too long for its frame.
components.css: .ds-mnote { font: italic 12.5px/1.45 Archivo, sans-serif; color: #393c43; padding-left: 14px; border-left: 1px dashed #a9adb4; } .ds-mnote b { display: block; font-style: normal; font-weight: 700; } .ds-review b { color: #b8102d; } .ds-fixed b { color: #005f99; }

components.name: Control Strip
components.description: CMYK patches at 100/50/25%; along the hero sheet's foot and as the progress bar.
components.css: .ds-strip { display: flex; gap: 1px; height: 12px; } .ds-strip span { flex: 1; } .ds-strip span:nth-child(1) { background: #00a0de; } .ds-strip span:nth-child(2) { background: #e4007c; } .ds-strip span:nth-child(3) { background: #ffe000; } .ds-strip span:nth-child(4) { background: #16171a; }

narrative.overview: Kartouche's output is a proof you check and sign off, so every screen is a press proof lying on the press table. Documents sit on white sheets with corner crop marks and a slug line; a CMYK control strip runs along the foot of the main sheet; whatever Kartouche changed or doubts is marked in the margin the way a proofreader marks a proof.
keyCharacteristics: Sheets on a table: content lives on white (or, in dark mode, graphite) sheets with crop marks, never in nested cards.
Ink by job: black for text and actions, cyan for measurement and automatic fixes, pencil red for anything a person must check, yellow highlighter behind flagged text.
Slug lines in condensed caps carry file, page and status, as on a real proof.
The document's own text is shown in the document's own sans; the interface speaks Archivo.

rules.name: The Ink-by-Job Rule
rules.body: Each process colour has one job. Cyan never marks a problem, pencil red never decorates, and the swatch colours never leave the control strip.

rules.name: The Pencil Means a Person Rule
rules.body: If something is pencil red, a human has to look at it. Informational notes stay in ink.

rules.name: The Document Speaks Its Own Font Rule
rules.body: Text that came from the user's document is shown in the document sans (or Noto Sans Arabic for Arabic), never in Archivo.

dos: Do put every new screen on sheets with crop marks and a slug line that says what the sheet is.
Do use pencil red only for things a person must act on, and cyan only for measurements and automatic fixes.
Do show document text in the document's font and Arabic right to left in Noto Sans Arabic.
Do keep motion to press feedback, the progress strip and the one-time tick; respect reduced motion.
Do define every new colour, size or duration as a token on :root and redefine it for dark mode.
donts: Don't nest sheets, or bring in cards, metric tiles, gradients, glass or glow; that is the SaaS template this product rejects.
Don't add eyebrow labels above headings; slug lines carry facts, not taglines.
Don't use the control-strip swatches as UI colours or text.
Don't use spinners or decorative motion; progress is the strip.
Don't add inline styles or inline scripts; the app's Content-Security-Policy forbids them.
